traps.trap: Plan A (Teo) is as-charged at private hospitals with no pro-ration; Plan B (Lau) pro-rates private inpatient bills to 55% and private day surgery to 65%.
Deductible depends on ward class stayed (C 1,500 / B2 2,000 / B1 2,500 / A-private 3,500), not the plan.
Surrender value table spans pages 3-4; the end-of-current-policy-year (year 29, 31 Jul 2027) row is on page 4. Current SV is year 28 (S$76,320).
Whole life is absolutely assigned to Straits Harbour Bank: monies go to the bank, Lau's 2004 nomination is REVOKED, surrender needs bank consent. Loan balance is not in any document.
Supplements trigger at 2 ADLs while ElderShield/CareShield need 3 ADLs: at 2 ADLs only the supplement pays.
Funeral advance S$5,000 is deducted from the S$15,000 death benefit, not extra (Chinese text).
Lau's AWL is S$600 this policy year (ANB 70) but becomes S$900 from the 01 Apr 2027 renewal (ANB 71).
The MediSave sheet is a reference table, not a balance statement; balances are not uploaded.
Teo's whole life has no funeral benefit; the funeral plan belongs to Lau only.
Funeral plan nominee is daughter Teo Mei Ling; whole-life nominee (Lau) was revoked.
